# Let me track the color permutation when clicking all slots once
# First record current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
current_colors = {}
for n in seg:
    if n['pixels'] == 16:
        # Find center of slot
        center_row = n['boundary'][0][0]
        center_col = n['boundary'][0][1]
        current_colors[(center_row, center_col)] = n['color']
        
print("Before clicking all slots:")
for k, v in sorted(current_colors.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

# Click all 7 slots once
click_actions = [
    {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 22, 'col': 22},  # upper1
    {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 22, 'col': 28},  # upper2

    {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 36, 'col': 28},  # lower2
    {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 36, 'col': 34},  # lower3
    {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 36, 'col': 40},  # lower4
]
action(click_actions)

# Record new state
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
new_colors = {}
for n in seg:
    if n['pixels'] == 16:
        center_row = n['boundary'][0][0]
        center_col = n['boundary'][0][1]
        new_colors[(center_row, center_col)] = n['color']

print("\nAfter clicking all slots once:")
for k, v in sorted(new_colors.items()):
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

print("\nChanges:")
for k in sorted(current_colors.keys()):
    if k in new_colors:
        if current_colors[k] != new_colors[k]:
            print(f"  {k}: {current_colors[k]} -> {new_colors[k]}")
